inputs.original_text: The owner of Blue Waters has said that Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything”.Perhaps this might be considered as an environmental tax. Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter...
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, here we go again. Another hardworking business owner, the owner of Blue Waters, is finally speaking some hard truths about big government. They are pointing out the obvious: the Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything”. That is the reality of overreaching bureaucracy—they just take and take from those who actually build and produce, offering nothing in return except more red tape. 

And now, what are the leftists and environmental bureaucrats going to do? No doubt they will try to spin this and claim it as some sort of justification for yet another burden on business: "Perhaps this might be considered as an environmental tax." They love inventing new taxes to control our lives under the guise of saving the planet. 

Look at what they actually focus on instead of supporting local enterprise and personal responsibility. They complain that "Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter..." Instead of teaching basic civic pride, personal accountability, and cleaning up after oneself—traditional values that used to keep our communities orderly and strong—these progressive institutions just want to tax our way out of a cultural decay that they caused in the first place. It is always about extracting more money from the productive class to fund their endless schemes.
